title: Building Your Own Agents
youtube_title: Building Your Own Agents: The Loop Is the Easy Part | The Agentic Crew, Ch. 15
description: The core of an agent fits on a single page. Everything that makes it good lives around the loop: a workflow first, context rebuilt every turn, tools sorted by side effects, humans as a tool call, and evals as your test suite. Build one, even a small one, and you'll get better at using them.
